title: 第28章集训第29章我们第30章底牌
content_zh:
王紫璇睁开眼睛，不可思议地看着自己的双手。一年了，她在凝气境七重卡了一整年，用尽了办法都突破不了。方圆只用了一个时辰，就让她连破两关，直冲八重。
“你是怎么做到的？”她的声音都在发抖。
“不是我做到的，是你自己做到的。”方圆收回手指，“你的天赋不差，差的是方法。你以前修炼的方法太保守了，生怕伤到经脉，不敢用力。但武者修炼就是在受伤和恢复之间反复循环。不受伤，就永远不会变强。”
王紫璇沉默了好一会儿。她想起父亲王啸天生前说过的话：“修炼就是在刀尖上跳舞。怕疼的人，永远成不了高手。”她一直以为父亲在说武技，现在才明白，父亲说的是心法。
“谢谢。”她低声说。
方圆已经转身走向岸边。“继续练，把八重的境界稳住。天亮之前，我要你打出八重的全力一剑。”
王紫璇看着他走上岸的背影，忽然问：“方圆，你这么拼命，就是为了给你父亲报仇吗？”
方圆的脚步顿了一下。
“不全是。”他没有回头，“我父亲临死前留下的话是‘不要给我报仇’。他不希望我走上这条路。”
“那你为什么还要走？”
方圆转过身，月光照在他脸上，他的表情平静得不像一个十五岁的少年。
“因为他走的路，和我走的路，是同一条。不是为了他的死，是因为这条路本身就该走下去。他从哪里停下了，我就从哪里接上。”
王紫璇看着他的眼睛，看到了那种让她无法反驳的光芒。
方圆转身离去，消失在竹林中。
温泉里的水波慢慢平息，月光重新洒在水面上，像碎银一样闪闪发光。王紫璇站在水中，长剑出鞘，月光下剑光如水。
她深吸一口气，催动凝气境八重的全部灵力，一剑刺出。
剑光如匹练，劈开水面，在水面上划出一道三尺深的沟痕。沟痕持续了两息才被水流填平。
凝气境八重。成了。
她收剑入鞘，仰头看着天上的月亮。月亮很圆，很亮。十四天后，青州会武。她一定要站在方圆身边，帮他砍出一条路。
夜风拂过竹林，沙沙作响，像有人在轻声低语。王紫璇听不清那些低语在说什么，但她觉得像是在说——快了。

卯时，天还没亮。
后山训练场上已经站满了人。方家十人，王家十人，二十个年轻人列队站在黄土场地上，晨风吹过，衣袂猎猎。没有人说话，没有人交头接耳。他们都是被各自的家主亲自点名派来的，来之前都被交代了一句话——“方圆说什么，你们就做什么。不要问为什么。”
方圆站在队伍前方，一身白衣，负手而立。
他的目光从二十个人脸上一一扫过。方铭站在第一排最左边，凝气境一重，精气神比几天前好了很多。王紫璇站在第一排最右边，凝气境八重，长剑背在身后，目光炯炯。中间是方家和王家的弟子，修为从淬体七重到凝气境三重不等，有男有女，年龄都在十六到二十岁之间。
“我知道你们心里在想什么。”方圆开口，声音不大，但在清晨的寂静中格外清晰，“你们在想——凭什么一个十五岁的少年来训练我？凭什么他站在前面，我们站在后面？”
没有人回答，但有几个人的眼神闪烁了一下。
content_en:
Wang Zixuan opened her eyes and looked at her hands in disbelief. It has been a year. She has been stuck at the seventh level of the Qi Condensation Realm for a whole year. She has tried every means but cannot break through. It only took Fangyuan an hour to let her break through two levels in a row and reach the eighth level.
"How did you do it?" Her voice was trembling.
"I didn't do it, you did it yourself." Fang Yuan retracted his finger, "Your talent is not bad, but the method is bad. Your previous practice method was too conservative, and you didn't dare to use force for fear of hurting your meridians. But the practice of a warrior is to cycle repeatedly between injury and recovery. If you are not injured, you will never become stronger."
Wang Zixuan was silent for a long time. She remembered what her father, Wang Xiao, said before she was born: "Cultivation is dancing on the tip of a knife. Those who are afraid of pain will never become a master." She always thought that her father was talking about martial arts, but now she realized that what he was talking about was mental skills.
"Thank you," she whispered.
Fangyuan has turned around and walked towards the shore. "Continue to practice and stabilize the eighth level. Before dawn, I want you to strike the eighth level with all your strength."
Wang Zixuan looked at his back as he walked ashore and suddenly asked: "Fang Yuan, are you working so hard just to avenge your father?"
Fangyuan paused in his steps.
"Not entirely." He didn't look back. "The words my father left before he died were, 'Don't take revenge on me.' He didn't want me to take this road."
"Then why are you leaving?"
Fangyuan turned around, the moonlight shone on his face, and his expression was so calm that he didn't look like a fifteen-year-old boy.
"Because the road he walked is the same as the road I walked. It's not because of his death, but because this road itself should be walked. Where he left off, I will pick up where he left off."
Wang Zixuan looked into his eyes and saw the kind of light that she couldn't refute.
Fangyuan turned around and left, disappearing into the bamboo forest.
The water waves in the hot spring slowly subsided, and the moonlight shone on the water again, shining like broken silver. Wang Zixuan stood in the water, her sword unsheathed, and the sword glowed like water under the moonlight.
She took a deep breath, activated all her spiritual power at the eighth level of Qi Condensation Realm, and stabbed out with a sword.
The sword's light was like a sword, splitting the water and drawing a three-foot deep groove on the water. The groove mark lasted for two breaths before it was filled up by the water flow.
The eighth level of Qi Condensation Realm. It’s done.
She sheathed her sword and looked up at the moon in the sky. The moon is very round and bright. Fourteen days later, Qingzhou held a martial arts competition. She must stand by Fang Yuan's side and help him cut a path.
The night wind blew through the bamboo forest, rustling like someone whispering softly. Wang Zixuan couldn't hear clearly what those whispers were saying, but she felt like they were saying - soon.
At Mao hour, it was still dark.
The training ground at the back of the mountain was already full of people. Ten people from the Fang family, ten people from the Wang family, and twenty young people lined up on the loess field, with the morning breeze blowing and their clothes hunting. No one spoke, no one whispered. They were all sent here by name by their respective family heads, and they were all told one sentence before coming - "Just do whatever Fangyuan says. Don't ask why."
Fangyuan stood in front of the team, dressed in white, standing with his hands behind his back.
His eyes swept across the faces of the twenty people one by one. Fang Ming stood on the far left side of the first row. He was at the first level of Qi Condensation and his energy was much better than a few days ago. Wang Zixuan stood on the far right side of the first row, at the eighth level of Qi Condensation Realm, with a long sword behind her back and bright eyes. In the middle are the disciples of the Fang family and the Wang family. Their cultivation levels range from the seventh level of body tempering to the third level of Qi condensation. They are both male and female, and they are all between sixteen and twenty years old.
"I know what you are thinking." Fang Yuan spoke, her voice not loud, but especially clear in the silence of the early morning. "You are thinking - why should a fifteen-year-old boy train me? Why should he stand in front and we stand in the back?"
No one answered, but a few people's eyes flickered.
